items.title: R.C.H. Smith Interview, 1975-10-02
items.q: Clareness, Rosie McHarg. It's a long time since I really thought about those people.

ctx.x: Who else did you hear live other than Horry's band? Who else did you hear? Who else did you hear?

In Los Angeles in those days, there was a guy named Pete Daly out of Chicago-style Dixieland band. He was quite good. Clareness, Rosie McHarg. It's a long time since I really thought about those people. I never was fond of playing that way. I found myself in New York in the 50s, 50 to 55, playing alongside an incredible roster of musicians. This was in the days with the Conrad Janus band. Conrad Janus on the Tailgate Five, he called it. It was a five-piece group usually. But we'd play alongside just about the…
